name: label_route_vs_probe
purpose: TASKS 216 test 3: the label route's own low-mode measurement against probes/low_mode_patch_run.py's, on D_ac28161d06, the folder whose repair lifted its lowest B3LYP mode from -7.48 to +7.05 cm-1. The comparison is of the measured columns along the directions the probe recorded, so the two pyscf versions' label Hessians do not enter it; what is tested is the displacement, the SCF, the blocked grid response and the central difference. Without it the corpus would slowly hold two kinds of repaired label

estimate.basis: four displaced points (two directions' worth per functional, one direction each) on a 36-atom molecule; the probe's own points took 542-736 s each on 8 threads

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 4096 MB, as the corpus repair ran
